text:
alex wu: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: PMs asked for a compact release cadence + fallbacks summary for API / Console / Optimize so squads can finalize sprint scopes. can leadership confirm sequencing and any changes since the roadmap doc?
jess carter: short: sequence unchanged — API GA first, Console (invite beta) second, Optimize v1 after. small updates to freeze windows and fallback defaults; details below.
marco r: can you call out exact freeze dates again? infra needs them to schedule kernel/AMI rotations.
jess carter: tentative freezes: API code freeze 2026-08-05..2026-08-18 (GA target week 2026-08-24), Console beta feature-freeze 2026-09-18..2026-10-02 (pilot onboarding late Sep), Optimize v1 freeze 2026-10-28..2026-11-11 (launch mid-Nov). will publish a one-pager with firmed dates.
sophie (prod ops): request: please include per-release owners, acceptance gates, and the exact rollback conditions. PMs want deterministic criteria to sign off.
jess carter: owners: API = eng-runtime (lead jess carter), Console = eng-platform (lead sophie), Optimize = eng-ml (lead rafael). acceptance gates (high level): API GA = 48h staging stability at >=99.9% + no regressions on core eval set; Console beta = RBAC + audit export + 2 pilot signoffs; Optimize v1 = validated quant profiles + cost-savings >=15% on sample workloads + quality regression <2%. rollback conditions: sustained p99 > 2x baseline for 5m OR error rate spike > 0.5% for 10m triggers automated rollback.
alex wu: fallback routing note from infra: will fallback to quantized variants be automatic for everyone? what about self-serve customers?
jess carter: fallback routing default: enterprise tenants = auto-enabled (opt-out), self-serve = opt-in. rationale: protect mission-critical apps but avoid surprising small customers.
marco r: infra follow-up: how many warm fallback variants per model family do we need to keep? we need this for capacity planning.
jess carter: infra should pre-warm two fallback families per model family (one moderate-quant and one conservative-quant). primary regions (NA/EU) pre-warmed; secondary regions cold-start acceptable. will add a table in the one-pager with counts by family.
sophie (prod ops): can product publish a short FAQ covering: pilot signup, migration assistance for Dedicated customers, and any billing/credits tied to Optimize pilots?
jess carter: yes. FAQ + pilot signup form + migration assistance note (concierge hours expansion for pilots) will be included in the one-pager. Optimize pilots get an early-adopter credit package; no base pricing changes at GA.
alex wu: compliance ask: any EU residency changes during Console beta for pilots? legal asked for a clear statement.
jess carter: no change to residency commitments for Dedicated customers. Console beta pilots will be hosted in existing region VPCs; any special residency requests handled via concierge and SOW.
marco r: action item: engineering needs the one-pager with dates, owners, gates, and fallback matrix by Friday EOD to lock sprint scope.
jess carter: agreed 94 i'll publish the one-pager plus a short checklist and tag @coord-bot to create the tracking issue.
coord-bot: Created RW-TRACK-8801 "Publish release one-pager + fallback matrix: API/Console/Optimize" assigned to jess carter, sophie (prod ops), marco r, due 2026-07-09.
sophie (prod ops): last practical: can we get the telemetry schema for API GA (events: route, model_family, latency_ms, error_code) before the freeze? infra/billing will instrument.
jess carter: yes 94 will post schema and a sample ingestion config by Thursday. if anything slips, will update RW-TRACK-8801.
alex wu: perfect. i'll circulate to PMs and Eng leads once the one-pager lands. thanks everyone. :rocket:
